title: Agent HTTP project persistence bypasses FileProjectRepo: .kairo/project.yaml never written at project root
repro: Import a project via UI (PUT /api/v1/projects/{id}). agent-data/projects/projects.json is written (flat record OK after WEB-202 fix) but <projectRoot>/.kairo/project.yaml is NOT created. Root cause: PUT handler uses diskProjectStore.Update (internal/services/workspace.go:217) which only writes the projects.json blob; FileProjectRepo.Save (internal/repository/project_repo.go:162) with its SaveProjectConfig call is not wired into the HTTP API. Downstream impact: internal/services/jdtproject.go reads .legacyflow/.kairo project.yaml to generate the JDT LS project model — Java language features may see no project config.
